pages.title: Demolition Derpy
pages.creator: A Sole Proprietorship
pages.description: Demolition Derpy is a 3D car combat game where the last vehicle running wins. Ram rivals in three arenas, including the Drop Zone, where falling anvils can finish the job. Earn coins to unlock cars ranging from a fire engine to a hypercar with thrusters. Change the look of your ride with paint, stickers, hats and effects for its tires and boost.

pages.title: Pixel Nono
pages.creator: Playful Cochon
pages.description: Pixel Nono is a nonogram puzzle that hides pixel art in a blank grid. Use the numbers beside each row and column to work out which cells to fill and which to mark empty. Check how the clues intersect whenever you get stuck. Each confirmed cell gives you more information, and the picture emerges as you solve the grid.

pages.title: Munch Mob
pages.creator: AMIK Consulting
pages.description: In Munch Mob, guide a swarm of clay gremlins through miniature scenes and eat whatever they can reach. Start on crumbs and grow enough to swallow cars, carnival rides and eventually skyscrapers. Keep the swarm moving when the cleanup crew closes in. Pickups and feeding frenzies help you extend combos, and the Goo Shop offers upgrades for later runs.

pages.title: Animals Arrow
pages.creator: bidsynet
pages.description: Animals Arrow is a puzzle about getting all the animal arrows off the board. Tap a piece when the route in the direction it points is clear. If another arrow blocks the way, work out which piece can leave first. The order matters more as the boards fill with more arrows.

pages.title: Alien Storm
pages.creator: FandomWire Marketing Management LLC
pages.description: Alien Storm is an arcade shooter about repelling an alien invasion. Drag to move as enemy fire comes your way, and keep track of both the attackers and their shots. Make room to dodge while you fight back. Your job is to stay in the battle and stop the aliens from taking Earth.

pages.title: Pop Fruit
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Pop Fruit asks you to sort fruit from bubbles into baskets. Put three of the same kind into a basket to clear the group and free up room. Each basket can hold only so much, so check which fruits you can group before making a pick. Later levels introduce new combinations to sort.

pages.title: DRAG & Match Maze - TILE
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: DRAG & Match Maze - TILE turns tile matching into a route puzzle. Drag pieces through the maze to bring identical tiles together and clear them from the board. Before moving a tile, check whether it will block another piece that needs the same passage. A match can free up a route for the next pair.

pages.title: Arrow Escape: Master
pages.creator: HolaStudio
pages.description: Arrow Escape: Master is a route-finding puzzle. Read the direction of the arrow and work out which move will take it along the right path. Check the layout before moving so you can see where the arrow is headed. Each new board gives you a different path to solve.

pages.title: Key Quest
pages.creator: isotronic
pages.description: Key Quest is a room escape game built around finding a Golden Key. Examine your surroundings for items and clues, then work out how to use them to solve the room's puzzles. Remember details from earlier discoveries as you investigate. A clue that seems unrelated at first may help with a riddle you find later.

pages.title: Jewels Blitz Legends
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Jewels Blitz Legends is a match-three puzzle game set among Inca temples. Match gems as you travel through sites such as Machu Picchu and unlock treasures along the way. Collect gold and artifacts as you progress, or take on the daily missions and weekly events for extra objectives beyond the main levels.

pages.title: Math Block
pages.creator: GameFiH
pages.description: Math Block asks you to build equations by sliding numbers and operators around a grid. Look at the target value, then arrange the blocks so the result matches it. Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division give you different ways to work with the same numbers. Solve the boards to earn stars and progress through 500 levels.

pages.title: Fashion Heroes Academy
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Fashion Heroes Academy lets you style three students as they train to become superheroes. Build looks for class, training and battles, then pair the clothes with makeup and accessories. Try a different style for each student and occasion, from everyday academy wear to an outfit she can take into a fight.

pages.title: Giant Crowd io House Capture
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: In Giant Crowd io House Capture, lead a small crowd through the city and recruit followers as you go. Use the growing group to claim houses and expand the part of the city you control. Choose when to gather more people and when to go for another building as you compete for control.

pages.title: Color Dodge
pages.creator: AJAY AJ GAME DEV
pages.description: In Color Dodge, steer a glowing circle toward the part of each approaching wall that matches it. Contact with the right color keeps the run going. Touch the wrong color and the circle bursts. Walls come from several directions, so spot the next matching section early and move toward it before it reaches you.

pages.title: Find Goods
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Find Goods gives you a list of objects to locate before the timer runs out. Pan around the scene and zoom in to check small details, then tap each item on the list. Tapping the wrong thing costs time. Find every requested object to clear the stage and move to the next search.

pages.title: Ragdoll Beat - Simulator
pages.creator: GeekPlay
pages.description: Ragdoll Beat - Simulator is a physics sandbox where you can drag objects onto a ragdoll and see how the impacts play out. Push or throw the character and try different combinations of props. Each level gives you another setup, and you can unlock more characters to use in the experiments.

pages.title: Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits combines billiards-style shots with numbered fruit balls. Aim a ball at another with the same value so the two merge into a new fruit. Think about where a shot will leave the other balls before lining it up. Build up the merges to complete the level.

pages.title: Idle Dairy Farm Tycoon
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Idle Dairy Farm Tycoon follows a carton of milk from the cows to the market. Raise cows, process the raw milk and send the packaged product out for sale. Reinvest the proceeds in workers and warehouse improvements. Automate jobs as the farm grows so that production and deliveries can keep up with each other.

pages.title: Pin Puzzle Love Story
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Pin Puzzle Love Story puts a set of pins between two characters who want to meet. Pull the pins in an order that opens a route for the couple. Look over the whole arrangement before making the first move, since opening one passage can change what happens in another. Reunite the couple to solve the level.

pages.title: Hide And Seek Blue Monster
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: In Hide And Seek Blue Monster, make progress while the monster is looking away and stop when it turns toward you. Use objects such as fruit, a soda or a glass of water as places to hide. Watch the monster's attention as you move between hiding spots and avoid being caught in the open.

pages.title: Road Race 3d
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Road Race 3d combines vehicle racing with parkour on an obstacle course. Draw to bring a vehicle into play, then react to the track with whatever vehicle appears. The result can vary from one attempt to another. Focus on getting through each section quickly enough to stay in contention and reach the finish.

pages.title: Stickman Santa
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Stickman Santa is a Christmas choice game. A stickman has run off with the presents, and Santa needs your help to recover them. Pick how Santa responds when the game gives you a choice and see what happens next. The aim is to get the stolen gifts back so Santa can finish his holiday job.

pages.title: Bullet Heroes
pages.creator: Ohayō
pages.description: Bullet Heroes is a team-based shooter set on 3D maps. Choose a weapon and work with your teammates during firefights. The game has several modes, so pay attention to the team's objective before choosing where to move. Use the layout to find firing angles and help your team control the areas that matter.

pages.title: Pumpking vs Mummy
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Pumpking vs Mummy is a Halloween contest for two players. Pick the pumpkin king or the mummy and race your friend to collect the flying pumpkins. Catch the balloons and return them to the treasure chest before your rival does. Candies earn money while you compete to bring in the required haul.

pages.title: Stickman Miners Wars
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Stickman Miners Wars puts you in charge of a king defending his castle. Hire miners to dig for gold, and help them mine if you need more. Use your resources to recruit warriors, then give the order to attack the enemy stronghold. Upgrade the king and his units as you gain experience.

pages.title: Muscle Challenge
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Muscle Challenge starts with a run and ends with a fight. Pick up protein and other helpful foods to build strength on the course, and steer away from junk food and obstacles. The strength you gain goes into the fight at the finish. Later opponents get tougher, and a two-player mode lets you challenge a friend.

pages.title: Bubble Letters
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Bubble Letters is a crossword game with floral backgrounds. Swipe or click the available letters to spell words that fill the intersecting blanks. If you get stuck, a hint can reveal a letter, and a hammer lets you choose which letter to uncover. Solve the boards to earn gems and collect flower pictures.

pages.title: My Little Car Wash
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: My Little Car Wash gives you 22 cartoon vehicles to clean. Pick one and follow the on-screen hints to choose the right tools for its dirt and stains. Work through the wash while the driver waits and earn yellow stars for the finished job. Switch vehicles to try a different cleanup.

pages.title: Offroad Life 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Offroad Life 3D takes large-wheeled vehicles onto mountain trails in different seasons. Guide your vehicle over uneven terrain and try out different trucks and wheel options along the way. You can explore on your own or use the two-player mode to tackle the mountain routes with a friend.

pages.title: Stickman Jewel Match 3 Master
pages.creator: Craft Game World RA
pages.description: Stickman Jewel Match 3 Master is a puzzle game about lining up matching jewels. Clear groups to work through the levels and collect the rewards. Look for moves that set off more than one match or leave the board ready for a bigger combo. The bonus blasts can help clear crowded sections.

pages.title: Jewel Royal Saga
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Jewel Royal Saga is a gem-matching game played on rows and columns. Bring matching jewels together and look for larger groups that can set off stronger bombs. The wheel offers boosters you can use when a board gives you trouble. Use the matches and bonuses to get through the level.

pages.title: LAST NIGHT
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: LAST NIGHT is a story game about a YouTuber trying to earn a Gold Play Button. The evening takes a strange turn when unexpected things begin happening on his computer and a survey enters the story. Follow what happens on the screen and see where it leads. The story has three possible endings.

pages.title: GPU Mining
pages.creator: Papi Game
pages.description: GPU Mining is an idle game that simulates earning money with a graphics card. Put your virtual earnings back into your setup to speed up production. You can upgrade the GPU and add hardware, then let the machine accumulate more funds. Use the higher income to afford the next round of improvements.

pages.title: In Space
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: In Space is a top-down arena shooter set on an alien planet. Survive for ten minutes while creatures swarm you. Start with a space rifle and earn experience from defeated enemies to add power-ups during the run. If you fall short, the shop offers permanent upgrades that can help on your next attempt.

pages.title: Bubble Monster
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Bubble Monster is a rhythm game built around tapping in time with songs. Follow the beat and time each input to the music. A song can ask you to react quickly as one beat follows another, so listen as well as watch. Replay a track to get more comfortable with its timing.

pages.title: Catch The Thief
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Catch The Thief is a puzzle about bringing a police officer and a thief into contact. Drag the wooden pieces to change the layout and bring the two together. Keep both characters inside the play area and away from hazards. An obstacle hitting either one ends the attempt.

pages.title: Age Wars Idle
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Age Wars Idle sends you through battles from the Stone Age to the Space Age. Collect weapons, use them against enemies and upgrade both your equipment and your era. The enemies change as you advance, with giants, cannibals and aliens among the threats. Keep improving your weapons to deal with what comes next.

pages.title: Cycle Sprint
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Cycle Sprint takes your cyclist to road races in Italy, France and Spain. Use the arrow keys to change lanes and Space to boost when you have room to gain ground. Customize your rider and bike before taking on the 63 races. Try to finish ahead of the pack and reach the podium.

pages.title: Max Danger
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Max Danger is a platform game with 20 levels and hazards that can be easy to miss. Move through each stage while watching for dangers that the route does not immediately reveal. Pay attention to where a run goes wrong. What you learn about a section can help you get farther the next time.

pages.title: Coffee Stack
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Coffee Stack is a collection game set on a conveyor course. Gather cups, cup parts and coffee as you move along the track. Watch for traps and reaching hands that can take cups from your stack. Steer toward the supplies you need and try to reach the end with as many cups as possible.

pages.title: Dominoes BIG
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Dominoes BIG follows the matching rules of a traditional domino game. The highest double in play opens the round. On later turns, attach a tile to an open end showing the same number of pips. Empty your hand first to win. If play gets blocked, the lowest pip total among the remaining hands wins.

pages.title: Boom Battle Arena
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Boom Battle Arena sends Pirate King or Tomato Boy through stages with bombs and enemies. Place explosives to defeat your opponents and collect items as you go. Find the castle icon once the enemies are gone to advance. Spend earned points between levels to improve bomb abilities or movement speed.

pages.title: Stick Transform
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: In Stick Transform, change the runner's form as obstacles come into view. Each stick figure can do something different, so pick the form that can get through the next section and switch again when the route changes. Make the transformations in time to reach the end of the level and collect its reward.

pages.title: Dirt Bike Extreme Parkour
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Dirt Bike Extreme Parkour is a timed motocross stunt game. Ride over obstacles, try stunts and collect stars as you work toward a faster finish. Spend in-game gold on bike upgrades or another ride. Return to earlier tracks to see whether your new setup and a cleaner run can improve your record.

pages.title: Kingdom Guards Tower Defense
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Kingdom Guards Tower Defense puts archers in charge of protecting a tower. Aim their arrows toward incoming enemies and bring the attackers down before they reach the defenses. Watch where the next threat is coming from so you can redirect your fire. The job is to keep the tower standing through the assault.

pages.title: Color Fantasy Runner
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Color Fantasy Runner combines an obstacle-course run with a fight at the finish. Pick up items that match your runner's color to grow larger and stronger. Pay attention to which items are in your path and line up the useful pickups. The size you build along the way helps you take on the opponent waiting at the end.

pages.title: Yummy Super Burger
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Run a burger stand in Yummy Super Burger. Follow the preparation list to get the ingredients ready, then make the burgers and serve the waiting customers. The cooking steps need to be done in order, and service is timed. Work quickly through the prep so you can hand over each burger when it is needed.

pages.title: Magic Adventure School
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Magic Adventure School puts you in charge of a potion shop at a school for witches and wizards. Work through the potion-making tasks and pay attention to each preparation step. The shop gives you a place to practice the brewing that your character needs to learn on the way to becoming a witch.

pages.title: Dr Panda Restaurant
pages.creator: Dr. Panda LTD
pages.description: Dr Panda Restaurant has you cook and serve meals to animal customers. Prepare dishes and drinks such as pizza, soup, apple pie and fruit smoothies, then bring the finished food to the guests. When a table is free, tidy it up and sort the garbage for recycling before moving on to the next meal.

pages.title: Poly Art
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Poly Art gives you pictures in pieces. Move the cluster of shards until they line up and reveal the finished image. Look for pieces that form a recognizable edge or shape as you adjust the view. The puzzles turn into subjects such as animals, flowers, plants and vehicles once the fragments come together.

pages.title: Parrot Simulator
pages.creator: CyberGoldfinch
pages.description: Parrot Simulator starts you as a small parrot on a tropical island. Search for food and watch for predators both in the air and on the ground. Explore new areas as you learn where to find what you need, then develop a flock of your own. Staying fed and safe gives you room to explore.

pages.title: Paw Care
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Paw Care puts you to work at a 3D pet clinic. One job is to trim a pet's claws. Position the clippers at the nail and make a careful cut, then continue through the care tasks for the animal in front of you. Work on each paw before moving on to the next patient.

pages.title: Klondike Solitaire
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Klondike Solitaire deals a fresh layout of the classic card puzzle. Arrange cards in descending order by alternating red and black in the columns, then build the foundations from ace upward by suit. Uncover cards by moving the stacks that cover them. If you cannot spot a legal move, you can ask for a hint.

pages.title: Tower of Colors Island Edition
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Tower of Colors Island Edition asks you to dismantle a tower with colored shots. Rotate the tower until you see blocks that match your ball, then aim for them. Collect coins to use power-ups such as a wildcard or spinning laser. Turning the tower can reveal matching blocks you could not see from the first angle.

pages.title: Desafio gamer 2
pages.creator: Nicolas Tacgorian
pages.description: Desafio gamer 2 is a survival challenge where you steer around enemies and grab coins while Viki tries to distract you with her comments. Use the mouse or touch controls to keep moving and stay in play as long as possible. Spend the coins you collect on new character skins.

pages.title: City Car Stunt 3
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: City Car Stunt 3 puts six stunt routes on the clock. Finish each one before time expires to unlock a new car. Use nitro when the course gives you room to accelerate. Drive alone or share the keyboard with a second player, with separate steering and boost controls for each driver.

pages.title: Wobble Boss
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Wobble Boss is an office escape game. Move through the building with the arrow keys or by swiping, and watch for guards as you look for a route out. Doors divide the office into sections, so look ahead before choosing a direction and move on when you see an opening.

pages.title: Chubby Runner
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Chubby Runner is a road runner with incoming vehicles to jump over. Tap to jump when a car or another obstacle reaches your path. Pick up coins and sandwiches along the way for points and energy. Watch the distance to the next vehicle before jumping so you have time to get ready for it.

pages.title: Bike Stunt Racing 3D
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Bike Stunt Racing 3D takes motocross bikes onto courses with jumps and rival riders. Use the arrow keys to control the bike and carry speed into the next section without crashing. Time your approach to each jump so you can get the bike back down and continue the race.

pages.title: ATV Offroad Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: ATV Offroad Puzzle is a jigsaw game with six pictures of off-road ATVs. Pick an image, then choose whether to assemble it from 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Start with the larger visual features and use matching colors and edges to work out where the smaller details belong.

pages.title: Brick Breaker 3D
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Brick Breaker 3D brings paddle-and-ball play to a set of 3D arcade levels. Move the paddle with the mouse or touch controls and keep returning the ball so it breaks the bricks above. Use power-ups as they appear and follow the ball's rebound when it comes off the remaining blocks.

pages.title: Old TV
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Old TV is a clicker about smashing a television. Click or tap the set to damage it and buy helpers to bring it down faster. Each new helper adds to your own efforts, so decide when to buy help and when to keep hitting the screen yourself. Keep at it until the set breaks.

pages.title: Fallender Ball
pages.creator: Kostenlose Spiele
pages.description: Fallender Ball is an arcade helix game where the goal is to get a bouncing ball down the tower. Watch the platforms around the helix and guide the ball downward through each section. Plan the next part of the descent while it bounces so you can keep making progress toward the bottom.

pages.title: Merge TD
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Merge TD is a defense game in which animals do the fighting. Combine two animals of the same type and level to make one stronger unit. Use the coins you earn to buy more animals and build up your defense. Stronger merges help you take on the enemies as you reach later levels.

pages.title: Alex 2D
pages.creator: jogosonlineapps.com.br
pages.description: Alex 2D is a side-scrolling platform game inspired by Alex Kidd. Jump between sections of the stage and watch for enemies along the way. Alex can punch, so you can deal with some threats at close range as you move through the level. Pick up money you find on the route and keep going.

pages.title: My Dream Aquarium
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: My Dream Aquarium lets you build a fish tank and care for the fish that live in it. Use the mouse to work through the aquarium activities and look after your pets. You also get to act as a fish doctor, so the game includes treating fish as well as setting up their home.

pages.title: Big City Taxi Simulator 2020
pages.creator: Smartline-Games
pages.description: In Big City Taxi Simulator 2020, take a job as a cab driver using your own car. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys, and use Space for the handbrake. You can switch the camera, look behind the car, toggle the lights and turn the engine on or off as you drive around the city.

pages.title: Bike Impossible Tracks Challenges
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Bike Impossible Tracks Challenges puts a motorcycle through a series of demanding courses. Steer and brake with the arrow keys or WASD, use Left Shift for nitro and press Space for the handbrake. Take the slower sections carefully and save the boost for stretches where you can keep the bike under control.

pages.title: Tank Battle Multiplayer
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Tank Battle Multiplayer is an online tank combat game about defending your territory. Drive with the arrow keys and use the mouse during combat. Pay attention to where opponents approach so you can position your tank to meet them. Keep your vehicle moving as you fight to hold the area.

pages.title: Multiplayer 4x4 offroad drive
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Multiplayer 4x4 offroad drive is an off-road driving simulator with a multiplayer mode. Take a four-wheel-drive vehicle out on the terrain and challenge other drivers. There are also driving missions to complete as you work toward more 4x4 options. Try the different vehicles as they become available to see how they handle.

pages.title: Skyline R34 Drift 3D
pages.creator: Smartline-Games
pages.description: Skyline R34 Drift 3D puts you behind the wheel of a Nissan Skyline GT-R R34. Tune the car, take it racing or see how it handles in a drift. The Drift Challenge gives you a way to put a setup to the test. Adjust the tune and try again to see how the car responds.

pages.title: Amusement Park Hidden Stars
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Amusement Park Hidden Stars hides ten stars in each of six park pictures. Search the rides and scenery for every star before time expires. Take care with uncertain clicks, since repeated misses cost five extra seconds. Clear a picture by finding all ten and move on to the next search.

pages.title: Dragon Blast
pages.creator: Plug in Digital
pages.description: Dragon Blast is a shooting game about getting a dragon to Earth's surface. Click to fire at the enemies in its way and time your shots as the dragon advances. Keep the dragon away from the wall opposite it. Contact with that wall ends the run, so watch the dragon's position as you shoot.

pages.title: Gravity Russian Tumbler Toy
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Gravity Russian Tumbler Toy gives you control of a toy by letting you switch gravity. Reverse the pull at the right moment to get around obstacles and guide the tumbler to the target. The game has 30 levels, with a new layout to read each time before committing to a switch.

pages.title: Pumpkin Ice Cream
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Pumpkin Ice Cream is a step-by-step cooking game. Follow the prompts to prepare and roast the pumpkin, then turn the flesh into purée. Work through the mixing steps with the other ingredients to make the ice cream. The game shows you what to do at each stage, from preparing the pumpkin to finishing the dessert.

pages.title: Crazy Daycare Nanny Mania
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Crazy Daycare Nanny Mania puts you in charge of a restless baby while her parents take a break. Take on the babysitting activities and respond to what the baby needs as you go. The game also includes a makeover for the nanny, giving you a change of pace from the daycare tasks.

pages.title: Ping Pong Goal
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Ping Pong Goal plays like soccer with a paddle. Drag your paddle up and down to return the ball and try to get it past your opponent. Guard your side as you set up the next shot. The first player to put five goals past the other wins the match.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Ballerina Dance
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Ballerina Dance follows Hazel from her morning routine to her first dance lesson. Help her complete the shower-time tasks to receive ballerina toys from her mother. At class, Hazel is nervous. Encourage her so she can settle in and follow the teacher's instructions as she learns the dance.

pages.title: Math Whizz
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Math Whizz gives you one minute to solve as many equations as possible. Read each problem and use the mouse to select your answer. Move quickly enough to make use of the clock while checking your arithmetic before you respond. Try another round to see how many more you can solve.

pages.title: EG Duck Shooter
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Duck Shooter is a carnival shooting gallery that speeds up as you score. Aim at the yellow ducks to earn points and let the red ones pass. Hitting a red duck reduces your score. Pick your targets carefully as the pace rises and there is less time to tell the colors apart.

pages.title: Royal Queen Vs Modern Queen
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Royal Queen Vs Modern Queen gives Elsa two ways to dress as queen. Style her around royal tradition or put together a modern look that changes some of the old rules. Explore the wardrobe and see how each choice changes her appearance before deciding which version fits the queen you want to create.

pages.title: Classic Blocks
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Classic Blocks is a falling-block puzzle where you score by completing horizontal rows. Move the pieces with the arrow keys or the on-screen buttons and fit them into the available space. Keep the board low by filling gaps where you can. The more complete lines you make, the higher your score.

pages.title: Kids Cute Pairs
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Kids Cute Pairs is a memory game with pictures of produce, musical instruments and animals. Turn over cards and remember where the pictures are so you can find pairs. Choose from three difficulties or play against a friend. In a two-player game, a match earns another turn and the player with more pairs wins.

pages.title: Cat Doctor
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Cat Doctor puts you in charge of treating cats at a clinic. Use the mouse to work with the tools for each treatment. The jobs include cleaning up bacteria, bandaging wounds and looking after teeth. Follow the steps for the problem in front of you, then move on to another level.

pages.title: Basketball Bounce
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Basketball Bounce asks you to keep a basketball from falling out of the screen. Click or tap to close the brick barrier when the ball drops toward it. Close it in time to send the ball back into play. Keep catching the ball on its way down to build your score.

pages.title: Froggy
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: In Froggy, use the frog's tongue to reach the next platform. Aim before sending the tongue out and keep the frog moving from perch to perch to build your score. Pick up flies as you go and spend them in the shop on different frog skins. Try to beat your best run.

pages.title: Alchemist Puzzle
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Alchemist Puzzle is a potion-matching game played by dragging across the board. Link at least three matching potions in a chain to score. Look for routes that let you include more bottles before you finish a swipe. Longer chains help you raise your score, so scan the board before committing to a short one.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Halloween
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Halloween gives the bubble-matching puzzle a Halloween theme. Aim your shot to join matching bubbles and clear space on the board. Use boosters when the layout makes a group hard to reach. Each level has a star ranking, so you can work through the stages and improve your results.

pages.title: Perfect Prom Dressup
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Perfect Prom Dressup lets you help Bella get ready for a weekend party. Choose an evening gown, then find accessories that work with the dress you picked. Try several combinations and check how they look together before settling on the finished outfit. The challenge is to build a coordinated formal look for Bella.

pages.title: Stickman Ninja Dash
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman Ninja Dash is an action game where you use touch controls to take down waves of enemy stickmen. Time your moves as opponents close in and keep fighting as more join the attack. The game offers ninja outfits with different skills, so you can try a new look and a different ability together.

pages.title: Hole in One
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Hole in One is a physics puzzle where the target is a glass bowl. Flick the ball and see whether its path carries it into the bowl. Adjust the direction and force when a shot falls short or goes wide. Each layout gives you a different angle to work out before you can land the ball.

pages.title: Amazing Cube Adventure
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Amazing Cube Adventure is a platform runner about timing a cube's jumps. Watch the ground ahead and jump before reaching spikes and other hazards. Each level has a distance to cover, so keep watching the next obstacle after you land. Reach the end to move on to a new course.

pages.title: Wars of Worlds
pages.creator: Radical Play LLC
pages.description: Wars of Worlds is an online war strategy game that pits the magic of the past against the science of the future. Choose an era when you enter the game. The side you choose determines which world you represent as you face players from the opposing era in the same conflict.

pages.title: Mad Combat Marines
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Mad Combat Marines is a multiplayer shooter set on large city maps. Choose from several weapons and fight players around the map. Sports cars are available to drive, giving you another way to cross the city between firefights. Use the space in each map to reposition as you look for the next engagement.

pages.title: Girl Dress Up
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Girl Dress Up lets you put together a look with clothes, hair, makeup and accessories. Try different colors for items such as glasses, shoes and nail polish to see how they go with the outfit. When you are happy with the result, take your character to the disco scene and photograph the finished look.

pages.title: Instagirls Halloween Dress Up
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Instagirls Halloween Dress Up is a costume styling game. Pick a character, choose Halloween clothes and show the finished look on her in-game profile. Complete the tasks to earn coins, then spend them on more costume pieces. Build up the wardrobe so you have more options for the next outfit.

pages.title: Office Fight
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Office Fight turns office supplies into projectiles. Throw paper balls, pencils, erasers or even a monitor at coworkers before their shots hit you. Successful hits earn coins you can spend on more items in the shop. Watch for the mouse that occasionally scurries through the office, since hitting it earns a bonus.

pages.title: Frosty Princess Party Surprise
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Frosty Princess Party Surprise follows Ariel and Rapunzel as they plan a birthday surprise for Elsa. Decorate the living room first, then pick outfits for the two hosts and choose presents for Elsa. The game moves from setting up the party space to getting the guests and gifts ready for the reveal.

pages.title: Save The Cowboy
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Save The Cowboy is an archery puzzle about freeing cowboys before their time runs out. Aim at the ropes holding them up and release an arrow to cut each rope. Watch the health bars and make your limited arrows count. Careful shots let you finish with more stars.

pages.title: Flappy Dunk
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Flappy Dunk is a score-chasing game about guiding a flying basketball through hoops. Keep the ball at the right height to reach each opening, then get ready for the next one. Each hoop you pass adds to your score. Pay attention to the ball's rise and fall so you can keep the run going.

pages.title: Love Tester 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Love Tester 2 turns two names into a playful compatibility result. Type the names into the tester with your keyboard and see what the meter gives that pair. You can enter different names to try another combination or compare the results for several pairs.

pages.title: Beauty And The Beat
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Beauty And The Beat follows Belle as she gets ready to record a song and appear in its music video. Start by giving her a hip-hop makeover from the clothes in her wardrobe. Then pick a look for the video. Use the two occasions to try different styles for her new music project.

pages.title: Sniper Ultimate Assassin
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Sniper Ultimate Assassin puts you behind a rifle in a town full of criminal targets. Take on assignments and line up your shot carefully before you fire. Identify the target for the current job and use the scope to aim. Each assignment gives you another mark to find and take down.

pages.title: Eliza Donuts Shop
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Eliza Donuts Shop puts you at the counter of a donut shop. Help Eliza prepare and cook the donuts, then choose decorations to finish each batch. Make different kinds for the customers who come in. The game takes you through the work from making the donuts to giving them their final look.
